interpretation: Consolidated completion and preservation catalog. Priorities are delivery guidance; confirm contracted milestone scope. Entries are requirements, not claims of completed implementation.

requirements.title: Independent operation
requirements.acceptance: Clean checkout builds and deploys through company-owned accounts without Sites/ChatGPT/OpenAI runtime dependency.

requirements.title: Complete data and file preservation
requirements.acceptance: Obtain supported full live exports; reconcile record relationships, file references and auth mappings; restore-test before cutover.

requirements.title: Reliable mobile identity
requirements.acceptance: Normal technician sign-in, first-password flow and session recovery work without endless role verification.

requirements.title: Document and pasted-text intake
requirements.acceptance: Retain originals; extract available source facts from multiple supported files and allow reviewed corrections/partial saves.

requirements.title: Exact work-order references
requirements.acceptance: Preserve complete account-scoped external identifiers, meaningful suffixes and leading zeros everywhere.

requirements.title: Reopen the same existing record
requirements.acceptance: Inbox/task links open the exact saved order; concurrent edits and duplicate conflicts do not silently merge or create records.

requirements.title: Assignment and technician pay
requirements.acceptance: Administrator selects technician and agreed pay; assigned user sees exact job; client pricing remains separate.

requirements.title: Simple partial documentation
requirements.acceptance: Draft saves and normal work do not require optional maps, AI, complete CRM/biomedical profiles or premature finalization.

requirements.title: Durable notes and evidence
requirements.acceptance: Save throughout with honest local/server states, resumable uploads, revision checks and conflict recovery.

requirements.title: Microphone failure isolation
requirements.acceptance: Explicit start/stop/cancel; typed notes and save usable on denial, timeout, unsupported browser and late events.

requirements.title: Responsive forms
requirements.acceptance: Defer optional bundles and slow work; no lost newer edits or browser stalls during background operations.

requirements.title: One organized service packet
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed partner form where required, TechFlex report and captioned photos; correct pagination, original evidence and full reference.

requirements.title: Separate deterministic invoice
requirements.acceptance: Same approved revision; account authorization and terms; cent-accurate totals; invoice outside service packet.

requirements.title: Contract-aware nonduplicate billing
requirements.acceptance: Prepaid/included service not charged again; ambiguity reviewed; rendering and retries never create duplicate receivables/payouts.

requirements.title: Server permissions and financial privacy
requirements.acceptance: Verify user/account/location/assignment/company for records, storage, AI and exports; hide internal costs/pay/margin from partners.

requirements.title: Truthful evidence and approvals
requirements.acceptance: Unknown data stays unknown; failed/unperformed checks do not become passed; preserve authentic approvals and outcome distinctions.

requirements.title: Idempotent finalization
requirements.acceptance: Retry same request safely after lost response; prevent duplicate submissions, report revisions, invoices and pay effects.

requirements.title: Linked business entities
requirements.acceptance: Accounts, customers, contacts, locations, contracts, work, assets and finance remain linked with history/search.

requirements.title: Usable scheduling and routes
requirements.acceptance: Shared coordinator/technician schedule and permissioned self-scheduling; Westerville origin default with override; manual fallback if routing unavailable.

requirements.title: Scoped partner portal
requirements.acceptance: Individual identities and account/location scope; requests, quote review/acceptance, job tracking and messaging.

requirements.title: Versioned account rate rules
requirements.acceptance: Preserve accepted snapshots, rate overrides and account terms; private configured 40 percent gross-margin guardrail distinguished from markup.

requirements.title: Safe facility asset import
requirements.acceptance: Preview/map rows, retain leading zeros, explicit create/update/skip, no blank overwrite, collision handling and retry deduplication.

requirements.title: Scan and label exact equipment
requirements.acceptance: Camera/HID/manual scan; exact authorized resolution, permanent history and separately dated PM stickers.

requirements.title: Per-asset PM and approved procedures
requirements.acceptance: Versioned applicable source, measurements/units/instrument provenance, per-device exceptions and truthful facility summaries.

requirements.title: Provider-independent grounded assistance
requirements.acceptance: Independent replacement evaluated on actual extraction/research/transcription needs; source-supported reviewed outputs and manual fallback.

requirements.title: Verified website-to-CRM intake
requirements.acceptance: Review existing WordPress connector, correct field IDs, separate service/recruiting/newsletter data, authenticate and deduplicate.

requirements.title: Verified provider transactions
requirements.acceptance: Each agreed Calendar/Gmail/Drive/Maps/QuickBooks/800.com/SpinLife-FaST connection passes mapping, transaction, failure, audit and recovery tests.

requirements.title: Observable maintained production
requirements.acceptance: Sanitized PostHog/errors, release identifiers, actionable failures, backups/restore, documented deployment/rollback and costs.

requirements.title: Preserve training and school scope
requirements.acceptance: Separate learner participation, assessed competence and service authority; own-school/learner records and reviewed content revisions.

requirements.title: Multi-company licensing readiness
requirements.acceptance: Replace fixed TechFlex organization assumptions and verify tenant isolation, configurable brand/rules, onboarding and usage controls.

requirements.title: Proven optional hardware support
requirements.acceptance: Pilot actual NETUM C750 HID and NIIMBOT M2_H workflows; printers/instruments/NFC/native packaging only for separately agreed needs.
